metadata.title: Flow Finance
metadata.description: Track your checking and savings accounts with ease.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in with your Google account to access your space.
auth.loginError: Could not sign in. Please try again.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Compare your income and spending month by month.
analytics.chartSubtitle: Grouped bars per month with net balance trend line.
analytics.empty: No transactions to analyze yet. Connect your bank to get started.
analytics.motherTransferSubtitle: Non-payroll income (round amounts) whose label contains « {keyword} ».
analytics.motherTransferActiveMonths: across {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} with a transfer
analytics.motherTransferNoneInPeriod: No matching transfers in this period.
analytics.motherTransferNoneFound: No matching transfers found in synced history.
analytics.payrollTransferSubtitle: Transfers whose label contains « {keyword} ». Budget shift: {shift} month(s).
analytics.payrollTransferActiveMonths: across {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} with salary
analytics.payrollTransferNoneInPeriod: No payroll detected in this period.
analytics.payrollTransferNoneFound: No payroll transfers found in synced history.
analytics.outgoingTransferActiveMonths: across {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} with a transfer
analytics.outgoingTransferNoneInPeriod: No matching transfers in this period.
analytics.outgoingTransferNoneFound: No matching outgoing transfers found in synced history.
analytics.subscriptionsEmptyHint: Add your subscriptions and recurring debits in settings.
analytics.subscriptionsCount: {count, plural, one {# active subscription} other {# active subscriptions}}
analytics.subscriptionsMonthTableHint: Click a month to see debits for that month.
analytics.subscriptionsMonthEmpty: No debits detected in this period.
analytics.subscriptionsTableHint: Monthly: paid this month or last month · Semi-annual: paid in the last 8 months · Yearly: paid in the last 12 months (amount spread per month).
analytics.subscriptionsActiveEmpty: No active subscription for this period.

categoryAnalytics.title: Spending categories
categoryAnalytics.subtitle: Analyze how your spending breaks down and evolves by category, month after month.
categoryAnalytics.kpiTotalHint: over {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
categoryAnalytics.chartSubtitle: Stacked monthly spending to track trends.
categoryAnalytics.chartClickHint: Click a month to update the breakdown on the right.
categoryAnalytics.empty: No spending to analyze yet. Connect your bank to get started.

spendingFlow.title: Budget breakdown
spendingFlow.description: From income to every bucket, over the chosen period.
spendingFlow.otherCategories: {count, plural, one {# other bucket} other {# other buckets}}
spendingFlow.otherLines: {count, plural, one {# other line} other {# other lines}}
spendingFlow.summary: {income} in · {allocated} allocated · {rest} unspent. Transfers to your savings accounts and PEA count as savings, not spending.
spendingFlow.summaryDeficit: {income} in · {allocated} allocated, i.e. {deficit} more than came in. Transfers to your savings accounts and PEA count as savings, not spending.
spendingFlow.empty: Not enough data yet to draw the breakdown.

subscriptions.title: Fixed costs & subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Rent, utilities, insurance, mobile… Track recurring spending even when the amount varies.
subscriptions.manualDescription: Enter a name and a bank-label fragment (e.g. EDF, RENT, FREE MOBILE).
subscriptions.amountFlexibleHint: Enable for utilities, mobile plans, etc.: match on the label, not the exact amount.
subscriptions.paypalSectionDescription: PayPal debits detected by amount and billing day.
subscriptions.paypalPickClusterHint: ≥ 2 debits, or 1 last month. Use the icon to dismiss a false positive.
subscriptions.generalSectionDescription: Card payments and SEPA debits: same merchant across multiple months (dates and invoice numbers in labels are ignored).
subscriptions.generalPickClusterHint: Detected when the same merchant appears in at least 2 distinct months with a stable amount and a debit last month or this month. Variable amounts (utilities, mobile…) are added manually. Dismiss false positives with the crossed-eye icon.
subscriptions.pickClusterHint: ≥ 2 debits, or a single debit last month. Cancelled subs stay visible.
subscriptions.pickAmountHint: Each distinct amount usually maps to a different service.
subscriptions.noSuggestions: No unidentified recurring debits right now.
subscriptions.mergeHint: Attach the former label of a service that changed payment method here, to get a continuous history.
subscriptions.archivedHint: Archived on {date} · no longer captures new transactions
subscriptions.demoHint: Connect Supabase to save your fixed costs.
subscriptions.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
subscriptions.schemaError: Database schema is out of date. Run the Supabase migrations (recurring_payments, amount_flexible).
subscriptions.inactiveError: This debit does not match any detected suggestion.
subscriptions.rematchWarning: Charge saved, but linking transactions failed. Sync again.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.connectBankSoon: Set up Enable Banking environment variables to enable sync.
accounts.emptyDescription: Connect your bank to sync checking and savings accounts.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.pocketCreateFromLabel: Create an account from this label…
transactions.pocketDescription: For a Revolut pocket or a sub-account the bank does not expose. Transfers quoting the fragment below will be attached to it, and its balance follows from them.
transactions.pocketKeywordHint: It must be unique to this account. Revolut suffixes its internal transfers with a stable identifier — that is what we keep.
transactions.pocketBaseHint: What the account held before the first known transfer. Leave 0 if the history is complete.
transactions.pocketSaveError: Could not create the account. Try again.
transactions.pocketSchemaError: The database is out of date. Run the Supabase migration (manual accounts).
transactions.subscriptionDialogDescription: Every transaction with the same label and amount will be linked, past and future.
transactions.subscriptionMatchCount: {count, plural, =0 {No other transaction to link} one {# transaction will be linked} other {# transactions will be linked}}
transactions.subscriptionAttachHint: Use this when a service changes its bank label, for instance when moving from PayPal to a direct debit: the history stays continuous.
transactions.subscriptionAmountFlexibleHint: Enable for utilities, water, mobile plans, etc.: every matching label is linked even when the amount changes.
transactions.subscriptionSaveError: Could not save. Please try again.
transactions.subscriptionSchemaError: Database schema is out of date. Run the Supabase migrations.
transactions.subscriptionRematchWarning: Subscription saved, but linking transactions failed. Sync again.

savings.title: Savings
savings.subtitle: Checking account, savings accounts, PEA and crypto portfolio — balances and trends in one place.
savings.accountsSubtitle: The accounts of this space and their history.
savings.kpiNetWealthHint: Accounts + PEA and crypto after tax
savings.accountCount: {count, plural, =0 {No accounts} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
savings.noCheckingDescription: Connect your bank to sync your checking account and track your movements.
savings.anchorPointHint: Known balance at a point in time (not today's balance). Only movements after this date change the displayed balance.
savings.emptyDescription: Add your savings accounts (Livret A, LDD, LEP, Livret Jeune, PEL…), set a known balance at a specific date and transfer labels: their balances will update automatically.
savings.deleteConfirmDescription: “{name}” will be permanently deleted. Associated transfers will reappear as expenses/income. This action cannot be undone.
savings.formDescription: Enter the known balance at a specific date and the bank labels that identify transfers to and from this account.
savings.depositKeywordsPlaceholder: VIREMENT EMIS WEB M. PASCAL ALEXANDRE
savings.depositKeywordsHint: Comma-separated. A checking-account transaction containing one of these labels will count as a deposit into this account.
savings.withdrawalKeywordsPlaceholder: VIREMENT EN VOTRE FAVEUR DE M. PASCAL ALEXANDRE
savings.withdrawalKeywordsHint: Comma-separated. A transaction containing one of these labels will count as a withdrawal from this account to the checking account.
savings.schemaError: Run the savings accounts migration in Supabase.
savings.adjustmentFormDescription: Record a deposit, interest, or link a bank transaction to “{name}”.
savings.contributionSubtitle: Net transfers into your savings accounts and PEA, month by month.
savings.contributionEmpty: No transfers detected in this period. Link bank transfers to your savings accounts or set up a PEA plan.

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Give your savings a purpose — a goal can take just a slice of one account or of the PEA.
goals.description: Each goal is funded by a share of one or more accounts — savings accounts, PEA. Whatever is left stays available.
goals.overAllocationWarning: One account is allocated beyond its balance — adjust the amounts.
goals.addDescription: A name, a target amount and, if you have one, a deadline.
goals.targetDateHint: Used to work out the monthly effort left.
goals.noAccounts: Create a savings account first, or fund your PEA — goals are financed from them.
goals.allocateHint: A fixed amount taken from the account, whatever is left once the other goals are served, or the whole account. The last two follow its value. Amount set to 0 removes the allocation.
goals.demoHint: Connect Supabase to create your goals.
goals.schemaError: The database is out of date. Run the Supabase migration (savings_goals).

categories.title: Expense categories
categories.description: Create categories and keywords to automatically classify spending based on bank descriptions.
categories.keywordsHint: Comma-separated. Matching descriptions are classified automatically. Manual corrections memorize a keyword from the description.
categories.deleteConfirmDescription: “{name}” will be permanently deleted and removed from the transactions it is assigned to (they will become uncategorized). This action cannot be undone.
categories.colorTakenHint: Color already used by another category.
categories.colorTakenError: This color is already used by another category.
categories.nameTakenError: A category already uses this name.
categories.schemaError: Run the categories migration in Supabase.

settings.title: Settings
settings.spacesDescription: A space groups the accounts of one budget. Keep apart what should not mix: your own budget and a shared account.
settings.spaceAccountCount: {count, plural, =0 {no account} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
settings.accountKeywordsHint: Label fragments that point at this account in a transfer, separated by « ; ». Useful when the holder's name cannot tell two of your accounts apart.
settings.spaceSchemaError: The database is out of date. Run the Supabase migration (spaces).
settings.connectSuccess: Bank connected. Accounts and transactions have been synced.
settings.connectAuthError: Bank connection failed (authorization). Please try again.
settings.connectNoAccountsError: Bank auth OK, but no accounts were returned. In Enable Banking → Control Panel → Activate by linking accounts, link this person's account, then reconnect the bank.
settings.aspspPickHint: Pick the bank to connect. You can connect several, one after another.
settings.profilePreferencesDescription: Show or hide sections, and configure payroll or tracked income sources.
settings.modulesDescription: Everything is on by default. Uncheck what you do not want to see.
settings.payrollDescription: Keyword found in your employer's bank label (e.g. CYFYN). Separate from family support.
settings.trackedIncomeDescription: Family support and other sources: multiple labels per person, separate from Payroll. Cancellations (ANNUL…) are always ignored.
settings.trackedIncomeKeywordsHint: One fragment is enough: « PASCAL SOPHIE » matches « DE MME PASCAL SOPHIE » and « VIR INST de PASCAL SOPHIE ».
settings.trackedIncomeExcludeHint: If the label contains any of these words (e.g. ALUTEC), it is not counted as income.
settings.trackedOutgoingDescription: Track transfers sent to one or more people (e.g. children) via a label fragment.
settings.profileSaveError: Could not save. Please try again.
settings.profileSchemaError: Database schema is out of date. Run the Supabase migrations (profiles.settings).

crypto.title: Crypto
crypto.subtitle: Import your positions, track EUR investment and estimate flat tax if you sold today.
crypto.totalInvestedHint: Total amount you originally put in (e.g. €2,163). Latent gain and flat tax use the whole portfolio: total current value minus this amount.
crypto.emptyDescription: Import a file with columns Name, Address (xpub), Crypto, Amount, Amount in Euro.
crypto.transactionFormDescription: Buy, sell or manual movement to update a position.
crypto.schemaError: Run the crypto migration in Supabase.
crypto.error_schema: Run the crypto migration in Supabase.
crypto.error_prices: Could not fetch prices. Try again later.

pea.title: PEA
pea.subtitle: Track your Trade Republic holdings, bank-label deposits and estimated PEA tax.
pea.estimateNotice: Some quantities are estimated from bank transfers. Import the Trade Republic export to replace them with real orders.
pea.cashBalanceHint: Uninvested cash left in the PEA.
pea.plansHint: Set the bank-transfer label and the ETF bought with it. Each matching transfer credits the PEA and estimates the max whole shares purchasable.
pea.plansEmpty: No plan yet. Create one to link your €200 transfer to MSCI World.
pea.planFormDescription: A plan = a bank transfer matched by label + the ETF bought with that amount. Saving also syncs transfers already in your history.
pea.planKeywordsHint: Whenever this text appears in an outgoing transfer, it is linked to the plan.
pea.planHoldingHint: ETF or stock bought by this plan. Create the holding first if needed.
pea.emptyDescription: Create an investment plan above: detected transfers and CSV imports will fill the shares automatically.
pea.holdingFormDescription: ISIN, quote ticker (e.g. CW8.PA) and optional manual price fallback.
pea.tickerHint: Quote symbol (e.g. CW8.PA, EUNL.DE). If empty, a known ISIN mapping is used.
pea.manualPriceHint: Used when the Yahoo quote is unavailable.
pea.transactionFormDescription: Buy, sell, deposit or other plan movement.
pea.error_schema: Run the PEA migration in Supabase.
pea.error_parse: Invalid file. Check the Trade Republic export format.
pea.error_prices: Could not fetch prices. Try again later.
pea.clearCsvImportDescription: {count, plural, one {# imported transaction will be deleted} other {# imported transactions will be deleted}}. Bank estimates and manual transactions are kept, and holdings are recomputed.
pea.planIsinHint: ETF identifier (e.g. IE0002XZSHO1 for MSCI World Swap PEA).
pea.planAmountHint: Indicative. The real bank-transfer amount takes precedence.

investments.title: Investments
investments.subtitle: PEA and crypto portfolio, in one place.
